dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: So, how're you settling into Nod-Krai?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Good day, Lady Nefer. I don't think I'll ever settle in here — it's just so cold!

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: That said, at least this place is quite warm — if only I could stay here longer! Anyway, about that guide you were helping me find...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I've found you a suitable candidate, but she's busy right now. Be patient. I'll make sure everything's arranged.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: That's wonderful news! *sigh* It really is too cold here — I should warm up a little longer...
